analyticBridgesReviewed: Inverse-binomial coefficient ratio gives radius two; the ODE coefficient remains nonzero between zero and every actual argument; principal inverse sine is valid for the stated acute angles.
Theta transformation differentiation is locally uniform on positive parameter compacts, and its denominator is positive by its zero lattice term.
Hypergeometric beta representation has correct normalization and nonnegative coefficients; resulting endpoint exponents are integrable.
Harmonic-over-shift separates the zero shift before reciprocal-square summation; all regrouped terms are nonnegative.
Logarithms of the Euler product are real, absolutely summable and taken at a positive limiting product.
Fourier-fourth-sine evaluates both scaled frequencies within one valid period.
Elliptic expansion uses the parameter convention and a uniform bound below one.
Harmonic-square generating shifts and derivatives are justified by polynomial growth on compact interior subdisks.
Totient regrouping has an exact finite gcd-partition proof and nonnegative Tonelli terms.
